source.description: Synthetic V2.4 composition metadata bound to the frozen V2.1 sampling Fixture output; it is not market data.

semantics.prices: The execution quote is read from the persisted v2.1-snapshot-sampling-1 observation; expected price is fixed at 10.2500 CNY.

expectedAssertions.description: A persisted fresh scoped sampling observation is consumed as the same TestRun Paper snapshot.
Repeating the same scoped fixture tick returns the original task and does not create another sampling result.
A persisted stale observation is rejected before FakeBroker order, fill or ledger side effects.
A lost order acceptance response is recovered by the original clientOrderId and the same sampled snapshot.
